training.notes: 211 FIA plots spanning 38 ALS projects across the southeastern USA; the published method combines an ALS canopy-height model with Landsat-derived stand age. Source: Gopalakrishnan et al. (2019), Forests 10:234, https://doi.org/10.3390/f10030234.

validation.notes: Site-index validation on the 75-plot FIA set; relative RMSE 19.7% at base age 25. The paper also reports an Appomattox-Buckingham set (n=23; bias -1.0 m; RMSE 3.0 m), not used for this card.

applicability.notes: Young loblolly pine plantations established after 1984; the published map is 30 m resolution. The method is not valid for older or uneven-aged stands.

notes: Published model card, metadata only. The source is an ALS height model plus Landsat age, not a linear predictor; its coefficients/raster workflow are not copied here. The card makes the claim inspectable; it is not a local validation.
